strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Reflection Amplification DoS (T1498.002)

analytics.name: Analytic 1140
analytics.guidance: Outbound spoofed traffic to known amplification protocols (e.g., DNS, NTP, Memcached) combined with abnormal network traffic volume targeting remote reflectors, resulting in disproportionate traffic returned to a victim

tuning.description: Interval for measuring sudden outbound spike or volume pattern
List of known ports used for reflection amplification (e.g., 53/DNS, 123/NTP, 11211/Memcached)
Heuristic threshold where the response volume far outweighs the request volume

log_sources.name: Windows:perfmon
log_sources.channel: Sudden spike in outbound throughput without corresponding inbound traffic

analytics.name: Analytic 1141
analytics.guidance: Spoofed outbound packets sent to amplification services from command-line tools or scripts, combined with abnormal outbound packet volume on known reflector ports

tuning.description: Sliding interval for detecting volumetric anomalies
Which protocols to watch (e.g., DNS, NTP, SSDP, Memcached)
Set of binaries and scripts commonly abused for spoofing/reflection

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Execution of spoofing tools (e.g., hping3, nping, scapy) sending UDP packets to known amplifier ports

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Outbound UDP floods targeting common reflection services with spoofed IP headers

log_sources.name: sar:network
log_sources.channel: Outbound network saturation with minimal process activity

analytics.name: Analytic 1142
analytics.guidance: Command-line initiated UDP traffic bursts to external reflection amplification ports using built-in scripting or binaries with network anomalies

tuning.description: Ports known for reflection abuse — DNS, NTP, SSDP, Memcached
How much deviation in outbound traffic constitutes a suspicious spike

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Execution of ping, nping, or crafted network packets via bash or python to reflection services

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Outbound UDP spikes to external reflector IPs

analytics.name: Analytic 1143
analytics.guidance: Cloud-hosted VM or container generates spoofed UDP requests to third-party services on known amplifier ports, with high outbound-to-inbound traffic ratios in VPC Flow Logs

tuning.description: Cloud security group rules permitting UDP to reflector protocols
Ratio threshold to flag traffic as potential reflection behavior
Cloud metadata that can help scope anomalous behavior to development, testing, or external-facing services

log_sources.name: AWS:CloudTrail
log_sources.channel: Create egress rule allowing UDP to port 53, 123, 11211

log_sources.name: AWS:VPCFlowLogs
log_sources.channel: Large outbound UDP traffic to multiple public reflector IPs

log_sources.name: AWS:CloudWatch
log_sources.channel: Sudden spike in network output without a corresponding inbound request ratio
